title: VKMS - FO Support
jobDescription: Job Description TX-SD Security Technologies Support: Function Owner Support in Vehicle Key Management System (VKMS) Responsibilities Key Tasks Our team is responsible for the secure and reliable management of cryptographic keys across the VW Group. The Function Owner Support role ensures that all aspects of the Vehicle Key Management System (VKMS) are coordinated, documented, and aligned with internal standards and stakeholder requirements. Manage and document change requests (CRs) using tools like Jira, DOORS, Codebeamer. Maintain and align QLAH content across brands and stakeholder domains. Participate in Change Control Boards (CCBs) and prepare delta documentation and confirmation sheets in line with VW Group standards. Translate functional requirements into structured specifications and test cases. Maintain test specifications across all levels (function, integration, blackbox). Coordinate with brands and ECU suppliers to ensure consistency and reuse. Track and triage defects, CRs, and feature deliveries with software suppliers. Align supplier deliveries with internal specifications and release documentation. Specify and review interfaces for production and customer service commissioning. Coordinate with backend system owners (e.g. FAZIT, System42) for integration. Define and maintain diagnostic specifications (Di DAS, DTCs, DDTs). Operate and improve key usage processes across brands and systems. Provide stakeholder support for function-related issues and deviations. Create and refine technical and procedural concepts (e.g. VKMS2 → VKMS3). Develop and maintain test concepts and specifications for all VKMS versions. Provide expert-level support for escalated incidents. Assist in long-term roadmap planning and strategic coordination. Contribute to the further development and evolution of VKMS within the VW Group, including new function variants, architectural transitions, and future security requirements.

jobDescription: Role Overview We are looking for a motivated and technically skilled software developer to lead the internal development and optimization of the Vehicle Network State Manager (VNSM). This AUTOSAR-based module manages vehicle bus activity through generic wake propagation and is fundamental to the E³ architecture. title: Security Lead -Incident Management
jobDescription:
About the Company Embitel Technologies is a Volkswagen AG (VW) Group Company. VW is a German multinational automotive manufacturing corporation headquartered in Wolfsburg, Germany. VW is one of the world’s largest automaker by sales. VW sold 10.9 million vehicles in
2019. The group comprises of 12 brands from seven European Countries: Volkswagen, Audi, Lamborghini, Porsche, Bugatti, Bentley, Ducati (motorcycles), Skoda, SEAT, Scania, MAN and Volkswagen commercial vehicles. About CARIAD (Car, I Am Digital) The automotive industry is in disruption. As a company, CARIAD is playing a part in multiple large trends at the same time: electrification, automation, and digitalization. The new name builds on changing customer needs. Automotive customers are demanding more comfort, more safety, more sustainability, and more connectivity. With its software platforms and digital features, CARIAD is developing solutions and products that will turn the car into a smart companion to accompany customers into the future with continuous updates and new digital features, even years later. The new company name reflects this zeitgeist: ‘Car, I Am Digital’. The brand profile can be found on its new website ( https://cariad.technology ). Currently, around 4,000 employees are working at CARIAD on the digital transformation of the car. CARIAD is working intensively on the software and technology platform for Premium Platform Electric (PPE). The first vehicles based on PPE will be the electric Porsche Macan and Audi Q6 e-tron. At the core of CARIAD is the development of the unified and scalable software and technology platform E³ 2.0 for all Group brands. E³ stands for ‘end to end electronics architecture’. The new software and technology platform is built from scratch and will be used first at the end of 2024 in Artemis, the lighthouse project of Audi. As of 2026, E³ 2.0 is due to be scaled by the Volkswagen brand with Trinity in the volume segment. About our Group CARIAD COE (Centre of Excellence) is setup in Bangalore, India working exclusively with CARIAD and associated VW groups with the focus on development of ‘VW.OS”. The areas of work involve development of platform components such as firmware, boot loaders, AUTOSAR, Linux/QNX BSP, Service oriented architecture-based middleware components. Job Description: We are looking for a SOAR/SIEM Engineer with 3–9 years of experience in cybersecurity operations to strengthen our threat detection and response capabilities. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with SIEM/SOAR platforms, cloud security, and automation of incident response workflows.

title: IT Head
jobDescription:
Job Summary: We are seeking a technically strong IT Manager to oversee IT operations, infrastructure, software development, and cybersecurity practices in alignment with ISO/IEC 27001:2022. The role involves managing secure systems, guiding development teams, implementing monitoring tools, and ensuring robust information security and compliance across the organization. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Technical & Infrastructure Management Oversee network architecture, firewalls, VPNs, and endpoint security controls. Manage on-prem and cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS, Azure) ensuring hardening, secure configurations, and identity/access management (A.5.16, A.8.3, A.8.5). Coordinate patch management, OS updates, and system health monitoring. Implement and manage secure version control and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Git, Jenkins, Git Lab CI). Cybersecurity & Info Sec Compliance Deploy and manage endpoint protection, anti-malware, and vulnerability scanning tools (e.g., Crowd Strike, Nessus, Qualys). Ensure implementation of SIEM and log monitoring tools (e.g., Splunk, ELK Stack, Wazuh) for threat detection and incident response (A.5.25, A.5.26). Participate in internal and external audits; enforce compliance with ISO 27001:2022 controls. Implement and review security policies, user access reviews, and encryption practices (A.5.10, A.8.10, A.8.11). Monitoring & Reporting Monitor systems using tools like Zabbix, Nagios, or Prometheus/Grafana. Generate regular security, availability, and performance reports. Track and report KPIs related to downtime, vulnerabilities, patch compliance, and incident response times Team Leadership & Awareness Lead IT support and development teams; assign responsibilities with security ownership. Conduct Info Sec training and phishing awareness campaigns (A.6.3). Guide developers and support staff on secure coding and data handling practices. Asset, Vendor, and License Management Maintain asset inventory and track software/hardware lifecycle (A.5.9). Evaluate and monitor third-party service providers for security compliance (A.5.22). Ensure software licenses and tools are compliant with usage terms.
